title: EVERY WAY HOME
statusNote: Published as a YouTube Short on 2026-11-04 (URL user-confirmed) with the delivered description. Twelve Quality takes from two book-ended positions, eleven kept, composited locally as translucent selves with staggered starts; v3 (25.33 s) approved by the director; the 4K finishing master cut from a 2x Real-ESRGAN counterpart with the v3 soundtrack copied unchanged. Technical checks, artistic approval and publication are recorded as separate events; real-time listening is not claimed. Archived 2026-11-04 under the standard retention: the 4K master, all twelve takes (including the rejected one), the plate and anchors, both composites with the median plate, the layer/mix/edit specs, decisions, recipes, ledgers and QA are retained; the v1, v2 and v3 native edits, their debug copies, assembly segments and the derived mixes were removed (20 files) after the master was re-verified.

credits.role: Concept, direction, anchors, motion generation, compositing, editing, sound

reviewEvents.evidence: Assembler verified full decode, 1080x1920, 240 frames at 24/1 fps and the source hashes. The mix report measured the soundtrack at -21 LUFS integrated, loudness range 5.5 LU, true peak -4.2 dBTP. Listening and artistic review are not claimed.

Assembler verified full decode, 1080x1920, 616 frames at 24/1 fps and the source hashes. The mix report measured the soundtrack at -21 LUFS integrated, loudness range 11.4 LU, true peak -3.2 dBTP. Listening and artistic review are not claimed.

Assembler verified full decode, 1080x1920, 608 frames at 24/1 fps and the source hashes. The mix report measured the soundtrack at -21 LUFS integrated, loudness range 11.4 LU, true peak -3.2 dBTP. Listening and artistic review are not claimed.

Finish command cut the approved v3 frame ranges from a 2x Real-ESRGAN (realesr-animevideov3-x2) counterpart of the composite and copied the v3 soundtrack unchanged; it verified full decode, 2160x3840, 608 frames at 24/1 fps, the base hash and audio identity (coded packet and decoded PCM digests equal to v3). Full-resolution crops compared against a lanczos 2x of the approved cut at the ending and mid-walk. Listening is not claimed.
Director watched v3 on the status page and wrote: 'that was absolutely perfect. Seamless. Great work. 4k upscale please.'

The director supplied the published YouTube Shorts URL on 2026-11-04 with no edits to the delivered description. Recorded as user-confirmed; the public page was not independently fetched and the platform publication date is not asserted. The local master hash identifies the delivered file, not the platform transcode.
